releaseNotes: v1.7.4: Light mode for the web portal. Pick Dark, Light or Follow device under Web portal in the app, or tap the new ◐ button on the portal itself, which each browser remembers. Dark stays the default. No Done needed. v1.7.3: Dark mode. The app follows the hub's light or dark theme (Hubitat 2.5.3+) and keeps its current look on older firmware. The web portal keeps its own dark theme. No changes to monitoring.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Device Health Monitor
apps.description: Learns each device's normal check-in pattern and flags devices that go quiet, with verification, locations, snooze, and a live web portal.
